page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text with Greek forms; no marginal notes; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: ὾ς. Dores hîc ε vertunt in η, ἐχω ἤχον.
3. ἑορπάζω ἑώρταζον, festum celebro, bam, retento ε, mutat o in ω.
4. Sequentia duodecim retinent οι: οἰαχίζω οἰάχιζον, guberno,bam.
main_text.l: οἰνόω, οἰνοον & ὤνοον, vino impleo, inebrio,bam.

page.notes: Greek forms are transcribed as far as legible; the scan is faded and several accents and breathings are uncertain. Catchword "οἰνο–" read from the lower right and marked as doubtful.
